summary: Fictional UK single-let logistics investment sold by two-round informal tender and taken to completion. Winner: Prologis UK at £57.6m unconditional (4.7% above quoting).

stages.title: Set up the deal
stages.narration: A new instruction lands. We create the deal folder and full filing system, install the master mandate-tracker workbook, copy in the NDA and Heads-of-Terms example templates, write tracker.json, and schedule the recurring chaser, the weekly client report and the internal team standup. From here the tracker is the single source of truth.

schedules.name: NDA chaser
schedules.prompt: Run manage-ndas for quantum-245-tamworth: chase any buyer 2+ days overdue since last NDA contact.

schedules.name: Weekly client progress report
schedules.prompt: Run client-report for quantum-245-tamworth and send the weekly progress update to Helix Real Estate Partners LLP.

schedules.name: Internal deal-team standup
schedules.prompt: Post the quantum-245-tamworth status to the deal team: stage, what moved, next action.
recipients: Deal team: Adam Moore (lead), Priya Shah (analyst), James Reid (associate)

schedules.name: Round 1 process letter
schedules.note: Fires on the agreed round-1 date.

deal.name: Quantum 245, Tamworth
deal.address: Quantum 245, Birch Coppice Business Park, Tamworth, Staffordshire B78 1SE
deal.vat_position: Opted to tax; sale to proceed as a TOGC
deal.abort_fee: £20,000 + VAT if the vendor withdraws after launch
deal.process_type: Informal tender, two rounds (round 2 best & final)

stages.title: Onboard the mandate + vendor AML
stages.narration: The countersigned mandate, fee agreement and vendor AML/KYC pack arrive from the client. They are pulled from the inbox into 00-mandate/, the commercial terms are recorded, and the Phase 1 checklist is marked complete.

tasks.task: Agree and sign agency / sale mandate
Confirm fee basis, abort fee, marketing budget
Confirm sale structure (asset vs share / SPV)
Run AML / KYC on vendor and beneficial owners
Confirm VAT position (OTT / TOGC) with client
Create deal folder, tracker and schedules

stages.title: Build and index the data room
stages.narration: Title, leases, the verified rent roll, service charge accounts, EPC, surveys, planning, warranties and the vendor DD report are delivered. Each is filed into its data-room category, the index is built, and the room is ready to open on a signed NDA.

dataroom.document: Official copies of register and title plan
Rent deposit deeds and AGAs / guarantees
Service charge budgets and reconciled accounts
Management agreement and managing agent details

tasks.task: Collect leases, licences, deeds of variation
Compile and verify tenancy schedule / rent roll
Gather service charge budgets and accounts
Build and index the data room

stages.title: Launch + log expressions of interest
stages.narration: The teaser and Information Memorandum go out and the deal launches. Six logistics buyers register interest by email; the inbox sweep adds each as a buyer record (NDA not yet sent) and files the enquiries. A launch-week update goes to the client.

tasks.task: Build and qualify target buyer list
Issue teaser, log expressions of interest

stages.title: Issue NDAs (chaser scheduled)
stages.narration: Each interested party is sent the NDA from the deal folder and the daily chaser is now live. Barings will be chased twice over the coming days and never returns it.

stages.title: File signed NDAs
stages.narration: Five signed NDAs come back and are filed into nda/signed/; those buyers are granted data-room access and chasing stops for them. Barings has still not returned its NDA and drops out before round 1. A weekly client update goes out.

buyers.notes: NDA issued and chased twice; never returned, dropped before round 1.

tasks.task: File signed NDAs, grant data room access

reporting.notes: 5 NDAs signed; data room open; inspections booked. Barings chased x2.

stages.title: Qualify buyers (AML + proof of funds)
stages.narration: AML/KYC and proof-of-funds evidence for the five signed parties is filed under 03-buyers/ and each is marked clear and verified, cleared to receive the process letter.

tasks.task: Run buyer AML / KYC and proof of funds
Run and log data room Q&A

reporting.notes: Buyer AML/PoF complete for 5; round 1 process letter scheduled 7 Apr.

stages.title: Issue round 1 process letter
stages.narration: The round-1 process letter (call for offers) goes to the five qualified parties and is filed under bids/round-1/. The deal moves into its first bid round.

stages.title: Log round 1 bids + report
stages.narration: Five round-1 offers arrive (£52.0m–£54.5m). Each LOI is filed under bids/round-1/, logged to the Bid Log, and a round-1 bid report goes to the client with a recommendation to go to best-and-final.

bids.conditions: Subject to IC and confirmatory DD

bids.notes: Cleanest R1; flagged appetite to improve.

stages.title: Open round 2 (best & final)
stages.narration: With client sign-off, the best-and-final process letter goes out to the round-1 bidders and is filed under bids/round-2/. The deal moves into round 2.
stages.gate: Opening round 2 is a client decision, the agent recommends it with the bid comparison; the client triggers it.

stages.title: Log round 2 bids + compare rounds
stages.narration: Four best-and-final offers come in; abrdn withdraws (redeployed). Prologis leads at £57.6m unconditional with a 4-week completion. The round-over-round comparison and a bid report go to the client recommending Prologis as preferred.

buyers.notes: Withdrew at best & final, redeployed to a competing asset.

bids.notes: WINNER. Best price, fastest completion, no conditions.
Strong; pipped on price and speed.

tasks.task: Log round 2 bids and compare rounds

reporting.notes: 4 R2 bids; Prologis £57.6m unconditional; recommend as preferred.

stages.title: Select preferred bidder + Heads of Terms
stages.narration: The client selects Prologis. Heads of Terms and an exclusivity agreement are drafted into 04-legals/, exclusivity is set to 27 May, and the unsuccessful bidders are notified. This is a judgment gate, the agent drafts; the client approves the winner and the HoT.
stages.gate: Preferred-bidder selection and Heads of Terms are gated, the agent drafts and surfaces; the client chooses the winner and approves the HoT.

preferred_bidder.notes: Unconditional, subject to contract; 4-week completion; 10% deposit on exchange.

legals.milestone: Heads of Terms agreed and circulated

tasks.task: Negotiate and agree Heads of Terms

reporting.notes: HoT agreed with Prologis; exclusivity to 27 May; solicitors instructed.

stages.title: Legals → exchange → completion
stages.narration: Solicitor correspondence flows in and is filed into 04-legals/: solicitors instructed, contract pack issued, searches, CPSE replies, enquiries answered, board/funding confirmed, contract engrossed, exchange on 1 June with the 10% deposit, and completion on 5 June. The legal milestones advance to complete and an exchange note goes to the client.

legals.milestone: Contract pack issued to buyer solicitors

tasks.task: Instruct vendor solicitors, issue contract pack

reporting.notes: Exchanged at £57.6m; 10% deposit held; completion 5 Jun.

stages.title: Closing report + fee invoice
stages.narration: The deal closes. The closing report and the fee invoice (£576,000 + VAT) are filed into 05-reporting/ and sent to the client. Final price £57.6m, 4.7% above the £55.0m quoting price. The mandate is complete.
stages.gate: Client-facing reports and the fee invoice respect send_mode, drafted and staged by default; auto-sent only when send_mode is auto.

tasks.task: Issue final closing report to client

reporting.notes: Completed £57.6m (4.7% above quoting). Fee invoice raised.
